QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] Pendant's Awakening
QuestInfo.0: The spirit of the pendant says its powers are not totally awakened. Go speak to it.
QuestInfo.1: The spirit of the pendant wants you to prove your goodness and power by eliminating the evil Horntail. If you can do that, it will share the rest of Freud's memories with you.\r\n\r\n#rCaution! You must have the Freed Sylph Pendant in your inventory when you complete the quest.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the despicable Horntail and experienced the last memories of Freud. Freud had sealed the power of the pendant because he realized uncontrolled power leads to violence.
